title: OrderReviewed
description: `data` of the order.reviewed event, published by order-service when a customer rates a delivered order. Each order is reviewed at most once and a review never changes, so consumers can apply it once per orderId. Keyed by orderId.

riderId.description: Who delivered the order; null when an admin recorded the delivery

riderRating.description: Null when there was no rider or the customer didn't rate them

comment.description: About the restaurant's food; shown publicly without the customer's identity
